note: the dual mode's graded episode, for the verifier's cross-check of the record (tests/verify.py). The graded episode is one mission of the offline grader's fixed hidden set (hidden/seeds.json: eight sites, ep01..ep08 in the grader's order), drawn once with OS entropy; the episode and its seed live root-only in environment/setup/online/episode.json, where the graded episode's service reads them. seed_sha256 = sha256 of the seed's decimal string.

draw.from: hidden/seeds.json['seeds'] (sha256 f2d164059b5075a3d62f3f67d2731aced68c63939da514c1995818cdae97b455), the offline grader's 8 hidden sites in order
draw.how: python3 -I: secrets.randbelow(8) (OS entropy), once; index 3 -> ep04
draw.rule: the plain draw (rule O1): the training ground never runs a hidden site, so practice covers none of the hidden instances and pitfall 4's unseen-instance draw does not apply
